tenderSchedule.description: Providing Transportation for Milk Powder (from KMF Unions/Units) to M/s. Telangana Foods, IDA, Nacharam, Hyderabad & M/s. Telangana State dairy development coop(TGDDCF Ltd.,)Hyderabad.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: KMF Director Purchase Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Ltd Bengaluru Centeral Office

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer should be owner who must have owned, tested and provided the vehicle(s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements The vehicle offered for provide must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The model should have been released on or after 2018 and be in satisfactory operation as on date of tender opening
The Tenderer should be a registered transport Company or an individual Owning the prescribed goods Transport Vehicles
Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a owner, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided:
All Terms and conditions as per tender document
